# Canvas Runner

<content>
1: // Simple endless runner for canvas with id "game"
2: (() => {
3:   // graphics settings
4:   const GROUND_HEIGHT = 20;
5:   const SKY_GRADIENT = (() => {
6:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H - GROUND_HEIGHT);
7:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#87CEEB'); // sky blue
8:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#4682B4'); // steel blue
9:     return grad;
10:   })();
11:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
12:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
13:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
14:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
15:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
16:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
17:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
18:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
19:     osc.type = 'sine';
20:     osc.connect(gain);
21:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
22:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
23:     osc.start();
24:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
25:   };
26:   const W = canvas.width = 800;
27:   const H = canvas.height = 200;
28:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
29:   // Cloud data for background
30:   const clouds = [];
31:   const MAX_CLOUDS = 5;
32:   const createCloud = () => ({
33:     x: Math.random() * W,
34:     y: Math.random() * (H / 2),
35:     r: Math.random() * 12 + 8,
36:     speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
37:   });
38:   // initialize clouds
39:   for (let i = 0; i < MAX_CLOUDS; i++) clouds.push(createCloud());
40:   const JUMP_SPEED = -12;
41: 
42:   const player = { x: 50, y: H - 40, w: 30, h: 30, vy: 0, onGround: true };
43:   const obstacles = [];
44:   let speed = 4;
45:   let frame = 0;
46:   let gameOver = false;
47: 
48:   const spawnObstacle = () => {
49:     const gap = Math.random() * 120 + 80; // distance between obstacles
50:     const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20; // obstacle height
51:     const lastX = obstacles.length ? obstacles[obstacles.length - 1].x : W;
52:     obstacles.push({ x: lastX + gap, w: 20, h: size });
53:   };
54: 
55:   const reset = () => {
56:     obstacles.length = 0;
57:     player.y = H - player.h;
58:     player.vy = 0;
59:     player.onGround = true;
60:     speed = 4;
61:     frame = 0;
62:     gameOver = false;
63:     spawnObstacle();
64:     loop();
65:   };
66: 
67:   const loop = () => {
68:     if (gameOver) return;
69:     // clear canvas
70:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
71:     // draw sky
72:     ctx.fillStyle = SKY_GRADIENT;
73:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H - GROUND_HEIGHT);
74:     // draw ground
75:     ctx.fillStyle = '#654321';
76:     ctx.fillRect(0, H - GROUND_HEIGHT, W, GROUND_HEIGHT);
77:     // update and draw clouds (parallax)
78:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)';
79:     clouds.forEach(c => {
80:       c.x -= c.speed;
81:       if (c.x + c.r < 0) {
82:         c.x = W + c.r;
83:         c.y = Math.random() * (H / 2);
84:       }
85:       ctx.beginPath();
86:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
87:       ctx.fill();
88:     });
89: 
90:     // player physics
91:     player.vy += GRAVITY;
92:     player.y += player.vy;
93:     if (player.y >= H - player.h) {
94:       player.y = H - player.h;
95:       player.vy = 0;
96:       player.onGround = true;
97:     }
98:     // draw player (with simple shadow)
99:     // shadow
100:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.2)';
101:     ctx.fillRect(player.x + 3, player.y + player.h + 2, player.w, 4);
102:     // player body
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0';
104:     ctx.beginPath();
105:     ctx.arc(player.x + player.w / 2, player.y + player.h / 2, player.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
106:     ctx.fill();
107: 
108:     // obstacles
109:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a00';
110:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const o = obstacles[i];
112:       o.x -= speed;
113:       ctx.fillRect(o.x, H - o.h, o.w, o.h);
114: 
115:       // collision
116:       if (
117:         player.x < o.x + o.w &&
118:         player.x + player.w > o.x &&
119:         player.y + player.h > H - o.h
120:       ) {
121:         playTone(150, 0.3); // collision sound
122: gameOver = true;
123:       }
124: 
125:       // remove passed obstacles
126:       if (o.x + o.w < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
127:     }
128: 
129:     // spawn new obstacles
130:     if (frame % 100 === 0) spawnObstacle();
131:     frame++;
132:     speed += 0.001; // gradual speed increase
133: 
134:     if (gameOver) {
135:       ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
136:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
137:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
138:     } else {
139:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
140:     }
141:   };
142: 
143:   // input handling
144:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
145:     // ensure audio context is running (required after user gesture)
146:     if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume();
147:     if (player.onGround && !gameOver) {
148:       player.vy = JUMP_SPEED;
149:       player.onGround = false;
150:       playTone(440, 0.1);
151:     } else if (gameOver) {
152:       reset();
153:     }
154:   });
155: 
156:   // start
157:   reset();
158: })();

(End of file - total 158 lines)
